# The worker API calls the hub's worker relay carries between one owner's
# machines: the cases of superagent.RelayAllowed (superagent/relay.go). Kept by
# TestWorkerRelayCalls (hub_surface_test.go), compared both ways with the
# source and checked against the function. "METHOD /path", one a line; see
# docs/architecture/guards.md "The hub's surface".

# What a router reads to pick a worker.
GET /api/v1/agents
GET /api/v1/agent-instances
GET /api/v1/super-agents/workers/tools

# Hosted workers on the other machine.
POST /api/v1/super-agents/workers/launch
POST /api/v1/super-agents/workers/release

# A worker's helpers (superagent/dispatch.go): a worker on one machine starts
# and reads helpers for its Ticket on the agent's machine.
POST /api/v1/super-agents/dispatch/start
POST /api/v1/super-agents/dispatch/read

# Running and steering a worker's invocation.
POST /api/v1/invocations/stream
POST /api/v1/invocations/steer
